arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse, re

# Check what TZ_PAT matches
TZ_PAT = r'(\s+[-+]\d\d?:?\d\d)'
tests = [
    ' +1:00',
    ' +01:00',
    ' +1000',
    ' +0100',
]

for t in tests:
    m = re.search(TZ_PAT, t)
    print(f'{t!r:15s} -> match: {m.group(1) if m else None}')
"
